name: Rashid al-Din Hamadani
contribution: A statesman, historian, and physician in Ilkhanate Iran.
image_credit: Jami al-Tawarikh artist, 1420-1430 artist · Public domain

checks.lead: Rashīd al-Dīn Ṭabīb (Persian: رشیدالدین طبیب;‎ 1247–1318; also known as Rašīd al-Dīn Fażl-Allāh Hamadānī or Rashīd al-Dīn Faḍlullāh Hamadānī, i.e. "of Hamadan", Persian: رشیدالدین فضل‌الله همدانی) was a statesman, historian, and physician in Ilkhanate Iran.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
